_comment: Scope for the local Lode test range. This is a self-owned fixture on loopback. The Console refuses 127.0.0.1 by design (core/targets.py:84 public_target_reason), so this file is meant for the CLI path — `lode.py auto --scope <this> --from-scope`. The engine's per-request gate is SurfaceScope.check_url, which admits an IP that is listed in allowed_ips and still rejects anything out of scope.
authorization: Self-owned local test range (ranges/lode-range). Loopback only, deliberately vulnerable by design, no third-party asset is in scope.
